sources.facts: City identifies the Old Mill Machine Shop at 95 Mill Street as the surviving building of the Roswell Manufacturing Company, beside Vickery Creek.
Old Mill Park contains the machine shop, 1850s mill ruins and the historic Vickery Creek dam.
Official visitor walking guide identifies a two-storey 1853 Machine Shop and 30-foot dam used by the mills.
National Park Service historic resource study distinguishes the Roswell factory remains, stone and brick fabric, dam and associated mill pond.
